app.name: Super Mario 63: Enhanced Wii Edition
app.coder: Super Mario 63: Enhanced Wii Edition contributors
app.long_description: Development scaffold only. Move the red square with the Nunchuk stick, Classic Controller stick or D-pad, or GameCube stick or D-pad. Jump with Wii Remote A, Nunchuk Z, Classic A or GameCube A. Exit with HOME or GameCube START. Story Mode is not implemented.
